label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The first Tab presses landed in hidden popups (region redirect button, an unlabeled Close Modal button, a GET 10% OFF promo button) before the page; focus went blank several times and I needed Escape to recover. The Skip to main content link only came after about 10 Tab presses.

The age stage buttons (Weeks 0-12+, Months 3-4+ and so on) never say which one is selected, and I had to Tab through all six to reach Continue. A video player and carousel Previous/Next buttons were also in the way.

Pressing Enter on a plan gave no sign it was selected. The paid Book Bundles add-on checkbox was already ticked, so I had to find it and untick it. Continue then showed no page change until I re-read, and the cart opened with no announcement.

Reaching Continue to Checkout took about 30 Tab presses through suggested-product cards. Each card has an unnamed link, a named link and an unnamed + Add button, and the carousel items repeat. Remove and Add buttons are close together and easy to hit by mistake.

The checkout page was blank on first read and only showed the form after a second read, with no loading message. The long State list shows [name] between [name] and [name], so it is out of alphabetical order.
